text: 10月20日，重庆市统计局发布2026年前三季度重庆市经济运行情况。根据地区生产总值统一核算结果，前三季度重庆全市地区生产总值25711.51亿元，按不变价格计算，同比增长4.3%，高于上半年重庆市经济增速（4.2%）。其中，第一产业增加值1526.64亿元，同比增长3.9%；第二产业增加值8573.74亿元，同比增长1.7%；第三产业增加值15611.13亿元，同比增长5.8%。（澎湃新闻）
text_en: On October 20, the Chongqing Municipal Statistics Bureau released the economic performance of Chongqing in the first three quarters of 2026. According to the unified accounting results of regional GDP, in the first three quarters, Chongqing's regional GDP was 2,571.151 billion yuan, up 4.3% year on year at constant prices, higher than the city's economic growth rate in the first half of the year (4.2%). Among them, the value added of the primary industry was 152.664 billion yuan, up 3.9% year on year; the value added of the secondary industry was 857.374 billion yuan, up 1.7% year on year; and the value added of the tertiary industry was 1,561.113 billion yuan, up 5.8% year on year. (The Paper)
